storyInfo: The Fourth Army attempts to seize the Sarcophagus, bringing itself to the edge of open conflict with the First Army. Tulin leads the people out of Zelgrad as it burns, while Crownslayer learns that Tulin is merely an assumed identity. The Rhodes Island team successfully extracts Kal'tsit's base-level code from the Sarcophagus, and resurrects her.

attributes.content: She broke her connection with that space just now, information flow is rapidly dwindling—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Come and help me out here, Mon3tr! I'm going to cut-and-paste all of Kal'tsit's base-level code out, I can't afford to leave a single line behind!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Data dump storage in position. Now, imagine this is a piece of hundred-percent reliable equipment...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I can't imagine something like that—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Then think of a way to use that telepathic link of yours to help me stabilize this weird code!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: What are you even talking about?!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: What I mean is, hold it steady!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Within the ad-hoc data dump storage, coded to be transparent, green 'calcite' emits a dazzling radiance.
We did it... I can feel it.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: It's amazing, isn't it? Both Kal'tsit and I used to be this small.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Closure does not immediately move to speak.
She does not even blink, staring at the storage's information display as it performs its pre-installed diagnostics, until she can confirm the code's self-cycling thread is still running.
The true end of the code relocation.
Oh, thank goodness! The Sarcophagus's energy output is stabilizing too!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But this is just the first step. This temporary storage has limited separation abilities, we can't keep Kal'tsit in there forever. Next, we need to find a relatively quiet environment—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Why the cluck is it so damn dark in here?!
<p=1>Zelgrad Sealed District, Sarcophagus's Core</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 14:33</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Ah, I think I can see—
...People?

attributes.options: Is this another infected lifeform?;Can infected lifeforms... speak?

attributes.content: I can sense soldiers outside attacking this place, Doctor. And this isn't the space we were just in, we've returned to where we started—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Hmm? What is this?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: That's rich coming from a girl with rabbit ears growing out of her head. What, never seen a chicken before?
This thing wasn't here when we came in!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Stop shouting, you're giving me a headache!
Listen, I'm no 'infected lifeform', and I'm no 'thing' either! I'm a chicken, a hen! Is that so hard to understand?

attributes.options: That term sounds rather familiar...;But you look like a little house.

attributes.content: Shush!
(Shakes feathers) (Looks around)
Something's not right...
Didn't Kal'tsit bury me outside that black thing? Explain to me both why I'm not dead, and why I woke up inside this thing.

attributes.options: This is the Sarcophagus's 'observation room'.;Welcome to ten thousand years in the future.

attributes.content: (Indescribable barrage of clucks) WHAT—

attributes.options: First, we need to think of a way to get out of here.;This miniature house knew Kal'tsit, we need to take it with us.

attributes.content: Err...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Did you... stop the Sarcophagus?
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Wait, how did you get in here? I thought you stayed up top—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: You walked away so fast, I didn't have the chance to ask... That ID code of yours means you must know Lada, right?
attributes.name: Klim
Amiya
attributes.content: Are you... Are you her father? And the one who helped Closure get in?

attributes.name: Amiya
attributes.content: Then you must know Alita Valueva—
The man shakes his head, letting out a distracted smile.
That's my Lita. I never could keep up with her.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Oh, you were asking about the Sarcophagus, right? Let me see...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It's currently stabilizing. The weaponized modules melted down during the energy offset. Right now, the energy output module is the only one still operating.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Ah, that's... that's great to hear. Lita always made the right choice.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: You saved a lot of people. I should... I should thank you.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: We should thank you too. Once we sort everything out here—
attributes.name: Amiya
Klim
attributes.content: You should leave immediately. The First Army is about to abandon this place.

attributes.name: Klim
attributes.content: When I was outside, their comms often mentioned.. the Fourth Army.
But isn't the Fourth Army still at the borders of the Central Governorate?
attributes.name: Amiya
Amiya
attributes.content: Are they coming to take the Sarcophagus?!
I don't know... Nobody knows all the details.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.options: We can't let any of the Armies get their hands on the Sarcophagus.;We need a way to hide it for the time being.
The energy gathered within has one logical outlet.;We can use this outlet to drop the energy reaction to its minimum.

attributes.content: ...You've thoroughly gathered information, and you're rather intelligent.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Alright, leave this to me. You should escape, and go do what you're supposed to do.
attributes.name: Klim
Closure
attributes.content: Are you going to stay here by yourself?!

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: This place is getting blasted by cannons! We can deal with it together, then get out of here together!
Enough...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: My wife died here... At least give us one last bit of alone time.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: But—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...I might not look it, but I'm actually one of the researchers here, too.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Now that some are dead and the rest have fled, I must stay and see this place through to the very end...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: That is my responsibility.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: <p=1>Zelgrad Sealed District, Surface</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 14:45</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: A large hole has been blasted into the stone wall's gate. First, dozens of people emerge on foot. Then come simple carts and stretchers...
Do a headcount, quick. Make sure all our people and the rescued Infected are accounted for.
attributes.name: Reunion Member A

attributes.content: We're in luck. The defenders are retreating, so there's nobody who can stop us now.
attributes.name: Reunion Member B

attributes.content: As the last of the people make it to the other side of the wall, a figure slowly appears from the dust.
That's where the problem lies. They retreated far too easily.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Not to mention the firepower and manpower we faced when we stormed the place isn't up to the standards of what a secret military installation would have. It's like they're deliberately withdrawing.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: ...And before we entered, some of the soldiers outside didn't even try to attack the evacuating Infected.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I don't know if they're dealing with internal issues, or if they want to scoop us all up at once. We need to leave right away, just to be safe—
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: An artillery shell nearly scrapes the top of Talulah's head as it screams towards the back of the procession.
Crying and weeping break out all around her. She looks towards where the shell came from—spotting the command bridge of a towering warship, the flag of the First Army raised high above it.
Bombarding their own damn city...
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Tell everyone to retreat using the route we planned out! I'll find a way to draw their attention!
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Talulah—
attributes.name: Reunion Member B

attributes.content: Just go already!
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: A second shell crashes into the ground, then a third... Rubble falls, the wall collapses, and the weakened Infected who just barely escaped death now only have the strength to wipe away their tears.
Members of Reunion rush about, half-dragging, half-supporting the Infected as they leave this place. Only one person watches the distant artillery barrage, stopping in her tracks.
Sirka? It's dangerous here, you need to evac with us, quickly.
attributes.name: Reunion Member C

attributes.content: No, you all go first.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I have something I need to retrieve, forgot it in the Generalik's residence.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Generalik! Please wait, Generalik! Please check your private channel, the Marshal is looking for you.
attributes.name: Flustered Officer

attributes.content: Out of the way! All of you!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Before you use my mother to threaten me, you should take a good, long look at your medals! Are useless wretches who quiver at the sight of a few traitors fit to call themselves soldiers of Ursus?!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: What are you doing here, Generalik—
attributes.name: Gunnery Officer

attributes.content: Who is manning the cannons? Have your worthless fingers degenerated to the point they can only be used to play cards?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I-I can explain—
attributes.name: Gunnery Officer

attributes.content: Don't think you can hide your dereliction of duty from me. Why are you not concentrating your fire on the gate? Why are the main cannons not yet ready to fire?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: We're not being negligent, Generalik. It's only been ten minutes since the order to retreat was issued. If we fire the main cannons now, many of the men still in the sealed district will be—
attributes.name: Gunnery Officer

attributes.content: There's still plenty of traitors in there too! According to the itinerary I drew up, as long as they're not stupid enough to shoot themselves in the foot, any friendly fire will still be within controllable limits.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I am tired of you using your bleeding hearts as an excuse, Lieutenant Colonel Bondarenko.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: A shining saber digs into the officer's neck.
Zelgrad is my city, but do not forget that it is also Ursus's city. Each grain of rye you swallowed since the day you enlisted was so that you would obey my every order today.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Generalik, urk—
attributes.name: Gunnery Officer

attributes.content: I'll give you one last chance, Bondarenko. I want to see the main cannons ready in five minutes.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Remember, there's more than one gunnery officer in the First Army!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...Ahem, Marshal, i-it's me... A thousand pardons, I know this is the Generalik's private channel...
attributes.name: Flustered Officer

attributes.content: Generalik, I dare not hang up on the Marshal. Please, take the call.
attributes.name: Flustered Officer

attributes.content: ...Give it here, then get out of my face.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: 'Soldier of the First Army', hah, what a worthless honor...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Respect those below you, Anatoliy. This is not the first time I had to remind you.
attributes.name: Voice from Communicator

attributes.content: But there is a more pressing matter at hand. You promised me, did you not? All you were to do was obtain the data on the Sarcophagus, then return immediately.
attributes.name: Voice from Communicator

attributes.content: Mother... I tried my best to get the results you wanted dearly.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: But you made me sit back and watch as those marrow-sucking parasites crawled all over my city, made me stand shoulder-to-shoulder with abject cowards, fleeing in disgrace—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You really do want to take my life.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Everything I have done was to keep you away from this meaningless battle, my dear.
attributes.name: Voice from Communicator

attributes.content: The Fourth Army approaches Zelgrad even now. Do you want me to look on helplessly as my own son is drawn into this fetid swamp?
attributes.name: Voice from Communicator

attributes.content: The Fourth Army... Haha, what difference is there between them and those traitors in the city? They have all turned their backs on this great empire, turned their backs on the creed you once taught me.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You were always molding me into a loyal pet, Mother... So why is it you who let go first?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...Bzzt...
attributes.name: Voice from Communicator

attributes.content: Talulah stops mid-sprint, looking at the distant giant as large as a mountain.
At first, she wanted to find an empty yet conspicuous place where she could release her Arts, using her own retreat to provoke the First Army and draw their attention.
However, all sound suddenly disappears from the warship. Not even the deployed secondary cannons make a move.
What is going on...?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: ...You repeat that?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You didn't mishear me. I am in your residence in the sealed district, using your private frequency to speak with you.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I am the spy dispatched by the Fourth Army—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Y-You're the one who tried to assassinate me that day.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Indeed. That is how Marshal Kuznetsov does things. Every important figure in the First Army is on his list. He has been plotting for three entire years.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: So are you begging me to throw you a lifeline now?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I beg that you cease fire for a moment, until the First Army can pick me up on your ship. As you and the Marshal had promised earlier.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Naturally, you will not only be saving my life... I am hesitant to say this, but I harbor a deep-seated hatred for Marshal Kuznetsov.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Young lady, if you have concealed the information I require out of 'hesitance', then I am more than happy to restart the artillery.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Why do you think we can trust a thief and assassin who has barged into our home?
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Your High Excellency, I am willing to give you all the details and spend an entire day verifying my identity, but the march of the Fourth Army will not stop.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I have a more effective method in mind: I will directly access Marshal Kuznetsov's private channels, and lead him into saying what you wish to know.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Wait—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: ...Yevsey? What news?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Marshal Kuznetsov, I am a spy in contact with Yevsey. Due to an emergency, I had to borrow his comms equipment.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I must first verify your identity.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I am the informant he planted in Zelgrad. My identification code was sent to the command center five minutes ago.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: 'Emergency', you say?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: The city is falling into chaos, and I have lost contact with him for the time being.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Civil unrest in Zelgrad?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Very good. Continue your report.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Many rebels of unknown identity infiltrated Zelgrad. They contacted the city's Infected, then launched an attack on the sealed district.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Part of the city garrison seem to be playing along, refusing to meet their challenge. The Generalik appears to be planning to abandon the city.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: (Deep breath)
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: A mutiny is brewing within the troops. A familiar situation, perhaps due to some outside influence.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Do you still remember the mutiny of the Cassian? Those troops who always supported your father to the last, but could not accept your military reforms.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Ancient history. They have already paid the price for their rashness.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Hardly a secret within the Fourth Army. My father left behind many festering boils. Many of our current policies had to be enacted to resolve the mess.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: If I may be so bold, are these 'festering boils'... 'debts of love'?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: ...Surely your intelligence has nothing to do with such flimsy hearsay?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I fear they are related.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: The entire Ursine aristocracy knew your father. Marshal Andrian was a model soldier of the empire. Loyal, determined, stubborn, and crude...
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: But they also knew he was one of the empire's most prolific lovers. The captain of the Cassian was his last sweetheart's nephew.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Right now, rumors are spreading that ten or so years ago, when army officials were in Grypherburg to report to the Tsar, he and General Svetlana Ulyanova Buterina, not yet Marshal—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Enough prattling! Where are you going with this?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: (Grits teeth)
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Though you have done all you could in the name of your family's honor, even killing your own father with your own hands without hesitation, to prove that such wantonness does not run in the blood...
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I regret to inform you that there are still those who do not approve of your methods, who are trying to deprive you of your inheritance, sir.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: So much so that you were never able to find the illegitimate daughter that Marshal Andrian carefully safeguarded, a wretched Kuranta... who is now in Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: ...Who are you?! Your voice—
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: More importantly, if you do not seize the chance to invade Zelgrad and silence her, she will soon bring proof of those 'rumors' to your loyal troops.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: When that time comes, your authority—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: ENOUGH!
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Distorting facts, trying to rile me into attacking the First Army—I do not know how you found Yevsey, but you have signed your own death warrant.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Hmm...
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: It is as you heard, Marshal Svetlana Ulyanova, General Anatoliy Svetlanov—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Suka!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Enough, Mother! I've had enough! That filthy mongrel spawned by Andrian has dared to slander the Marshal of the First Army.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I swear, I will kill you in the most miserable, humiliating way possible with my own hands! I will drown you in your own blood and see how long a khuyovy bastard like you can last in it!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Oh, Generalik, sir, I've been meaning to ask, have you ever met your father?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Perhaps one day, we will meet again thanks to this shared blood of ours... brother dearest.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Mother...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Do not be so easily deceived, Anatoliy. She merely wanted to goad you, though what her true goal is we can only—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Lieutenant!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...Yes, Generalik?
attributes.name: Terrified Officer

attributes.content: Relay the order, all men who are able to mobilize are to head to the sealed district to capture that woman.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: B-But we no longer have—
attributes.name: Terrified Officer

attributes.content: You won't live long! YOU HEAR ME?!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Don't rush, elderly and children first!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Raspy throats continue to cry out. Those helping with the evacuation divide themselves between both sides of the road, watching the people walk past them.
Intermittent explosions go off in the distance. The ground beneath their feet shakes. Some of the crowd seem afraid, but most of them stare ahead blankly, clutching bundles of their belongings tight.
Hey, don't go against the flow, that's dangerous!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Also, wear your gas masks as much as possible if you've got one, otherwise cover your mouth and nose with a towel! And don't touch any strange-looking animals—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Hmm? What is it, Lyudmila?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: This lady's fainted, got space on your cart?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Should be able to fit one more. Let's try it.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Lyudmila crouches down, passing the unconscious person on her back to them.
Lyudmila! Come over to the front, quick! Tulin might be in trouble!
attributes.name: Busy Miner

attributes.content: Got it.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...We meet again, Ratkov.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I shouldn't let you go free.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: My orders are to purge the traitors in the city.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: By traitors, do you mean the people behind me?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: All they want to do is save their own lives, those lives they have devoted to Zelgrad and Ursus. Surely this is not treason?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: There is still a chance, Ratkov—
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: As she speaks, the soldiers in front of her suddenly lift their weapons. Several crossbow bolts fire towards the space behind her.
Tulin subconsciously shrinks back. She turns her head to see Lyudmila standing behind her, effortlessly brushing away the bolts.
I was talking about her... but as you can see, we failed.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: A lot of people are saying Reunion's here. The way we see it, the First Army's defenses won't be enough to hold them back.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: If the Generalik still has a way to deal with them, then let him think about it.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: For us, we've decided to retreat.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: The soldier named Ratkov steps forward, grasping a folded-up plan. He shoves it into Tulin's hand.

Then, to the amazement of Tulin's followers, an entire company of soldiers lines up and marches away towards the left of the city gates. They march in silence, and the only sound they make is the tread of their boots.
He just decided that all on his own. Or rather, they did.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...What is it, Tulin?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: She sees Tulin unfold the piece of paper, hands shaking slightly as the eyes sweep across the dense mass of characters—eyes that are scattered, unfocused.
The paper tilts, then is straightened up. Tulin blinks rapidly.
Need help?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Ah, Lyudmila...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Could you... help me read what it says here? I'm having some...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: ...'The control room for the gates is on the east side, needs a standard password, check the appendix'. This is a guide on how to use the gates.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I see. Hand it over to my people. We can leave soon.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Some miners take the paper and leave. Tulin lets out a deep sigh.
Spasibo, Lyudmila. When I saw those letters, and how crowded together they were...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: And here I was thinking you were a bookworm.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I really am interested in the knowledge and tales within books, but most of the time, I need someone to help read it out loud. Because of that, I've always learned a little more slowly than others.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: But... 'Ivan Tulin'...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Ivan Tulin is a prolific author. Out of all the Ursine writers in the last few years, nobody wrote better than him, or more.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: University students in Grypherburg love discussing the complex, finely crafted quotations in his books, always proclaiming how well-read Ivan Tulin is.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You're—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: We did it, Tulin!
attributes.name: Eager Miner

attributes.content: ...Right.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Everyone! Listen well, for we are leaving Zelgrad!
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Great cheers echo through the city, as the people rush through the heavy gates.
Some lift their arms in joy, some kneel to caress the soil outside the city, smiling as tears form in their eyes, weeping even as the corners of their mouths turn upwards.
They look back at the road that brought them here, then turn forward once more, their footsteps ringing out in heavy, muffled echoes.
Once everyone has faded into the dusty distance, Tulin's throat quivers with a sigh barely audible to anyone.
Crownslayer sees Tulin turn away, though the hand gripping the pickaxe relaxes a little.
...Lyudmila, I'll need to find some other time to discuss the tale of that author with you further.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Many years ago, he was forced to leave us. Eventually, even I lost all contact with him.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Ursus may have mocked him, banished him, even killed him... but could never destroy him.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Because we are still here, and we still have tomorrow.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Twilight creeps up Tulin's determined face, those quiet words slowly lost to the wind.
<p=1>Assault Ship Volnov, Command Center</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 09:59</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: At least... I made it until the Morvan fell apart.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Hah... Time for you to fight fair for once.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: *cough*—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: It seems you have no need for your many comrades' lives.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: Get away from him!
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: (Ancient Ursine dialect) 'May his hand misheed its master's will, may his blade strike his own body down.'
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: Argh—!
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: The unsheathed chachek suddenly swings towards its wielder's neck, the sharp edge moments away from chopping through bone—

attributes.text: <color=#888888>Scioppa</color>

attributes.content: You—
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.text: <color=#888888>Scioppa</color>

attributes.content: I... Scioppa—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Get behind me, Oleg.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: And here I thought you merely a dabbler in Arts. I never expected...
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: You may live, but you cannot escape your fate. This means you need to die, a greater need than ever before.
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: You should've made those words into one of your spells, 'comrade'.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: But I'm not going to give you guys the chance. I know you can use silent incantations, but you're not going to be better than me at old-fashioned swift-casting.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.text: <color=#888888>Scioppa</color>

attributes.content: At nearly the exact same moment, countless vicious bolts of energy burst forth from the war caster, filling the entirety of the silenced space.
Every single piercing note created in an attempt to break the shackles of the spell is swallowed up into nothingness.
Get everyone out of the command center, Oleg.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I can buy you two minutes at most—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: —Such... feeble incantations—
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: Impudent parlor tricks!
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: (Ancient Ursine dialect) 'I shall have thee suffer, have thee walk an endless road, where even water pure cannot wash the filth off thy body—'
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: (Ancient Ursine dialect) 'Where even death shall grant thee no peace!'
attributes.name: War Caster

attributes.content: Quick—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: The adjutant quickly blurs in the Volnik chieftain's eyes, turning into stacks of blue, before becoming an endless white.
Extreme pain shoots through every cell in his body. Before his strength to resist is exhausted, he opens his mouth—
The final syllable of the incantation drops into place. Violet flames, so deep as to seem black, suddenly spring up, engulfing both sides of the duel.
—Hey—
Hey, wake up! Scioppa! Chief!
...What...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I thought I was supposed to be meeting the Viy... What are you doing here?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: *cough* *cough*! If I accidentally took you and the others with me—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You're not dead, and you didn't take anyone anywhere! I'm fine, feeling a little pain at most, but fine, really.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: ...I'm not dead?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Of course you're not! You jabbered on a bunch, then the entire khuyovy cabin went up in flames.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: But that black fire quickly died out, and those war casters disappeared.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: They retreated. Why?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: No idea, but it's a good thing all the same. I thought you burned them to death, to be honest.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I couldn't do it.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What're you talking about? You said you met the Viy, but I saw it slam the door in your face because of how much better you are than it!
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: ...Hmph.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What's there left to say at this point? Well, I say, have everyone ready to leave the ship ASAP!
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Huh? You still—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: That's right. I still need to give Kuznetsov one last parting gift.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Up upon the highest deck of the ship, the Kuranta watches his troops line up in formation in pensive silence.
The canyon chill blows past, blowing away the dust accumulated from days of regret, blowing away the watchman's fluttering thoughts.
You certain about this? There's still time to tell everyone to get back to their posts.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I'm going to teach that man a lesson, so that he'll never look down on us again.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: When everything's settled, I'll find you all.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: When everything's settled, huh... Will there really be a day when all our affairs are settled?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: There will be. There must.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Even matters that have gone unresolved for centuries will finally have their answer.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: The sun slants towards the west. Most of the soldiers take the scenic route, all to have more time to call out to the ones on deck.
Almost everyone leaving the Volnov looks for their chieftain to say goodbye, as if this is just their summer vacation, simply a short trip back to their hometowns—
Back to the fields, the forested mountains, the banks of a creek, laden with reeds.
Who's the bad guy you're meeting, who's so bad you can't bring us along, Boss? A giant, Baba, or the Viy?
attributes.name: Passionate Soldier

attributes.content: Well, no matter who it is, I'll sing you a song before you go! The one Oleg said you never finished singing—
attributes.name: Passionate Soldier

attributes.text: At the end of the road lies the Viy, not the tsar or any god I know♪
Just a monster of body big, whose eyelids need others to hold♪
Prayers? It hears no such thing, and those that meet it know it makes no sense♪
All they do is plop themselves down, like taking off armor they'll never put on again♪
When the Viy opens its eyes, you it sure won't see♪
All it sees is—♪
How your gift once made you you♪
At times it's war, a hate that spans the ages♪
At times it's a field that paid Catastrophe's wages♪
That wailing and weeping that never end, not even in dream♪
And once its eyelids droop down once more♪
You'll find some things have quietly changed♪
The river dry flows free once more♪
The children dead come home once more♪
All of these are impossible things♪
Which is why we won't sing for those going to the Viy's home♪
And why we won't carve their tale in stone♪
We pour wine on the ground, and with voices low we say♪

attributes.content: He's going down to the end of the road, all in our name♪
attributes.name: Passionate Soldier

attributes.content: Up until the second day when the sun shall rise again♪
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Still we advance, draw our blades, cut down our foes♪
attributes.name: Passionate Soldier

attributes.content: Still we bleed, fall to the floor, bury our dead with woe♪
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Still, history pushes us, back onto our own blades we go!
attributes.name: Passionate Soldier

attributes.content: <p=1>Zelgrad Expansion Plate, Forest</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: The Rhodes Islanders, accompanied by one noisy 'miniature house', finally emerge from underground after following Klim's hand-drawn map.
They find themselves within a secluded ornamental forest, where they are greeted by a bright blue sky.
...In short, I don't know how I got there either.
attributes.name: Noisy 'Mini-House'

attributes.content: Like you said, this is long after my era, which means I don't really have anywhere to go. But, looking at it another way, it means I can go anywhere.
attributes.name: Noisy 'Mini-House'

attributes.content: Hey, Closure, show me that 'mirror' thing, let me get a good look at my current body—
attributes.name: Noisy 'Mini-House'

attributes.content: You said you were buried near the Sarcophagus, and there was an Originium mine near the Sarcophagus's excavation site, which was one of the reasons why Chernobog was able to develop so quickly despite being in Ursus's wild east.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Some remains, an Originium mine, the former Sarcophagus... the 'mini-house', some blank Originium I accidentally spilled, and the 'prototype' whose functionality was disassembled...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...I got it. I got it!
attributes.name: Closure
Closure
attributes.content: Maybe I can try—

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: No, I need to try.
Closure?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Closure stops, rummaging through her bag before magicking out a foldable screen. She deploys it, then continues pulling out more strange things normally only seen in Engineering's offices.
She sits down on the ground, as the miniature house hops over inquisitively.
What did you figure out? If it's to do with Kal'tsit, then I haven't even mentioned her yet.
attributes.name: Noisy 'Mini-House'

attributes.content: I know she's dead, obviously. I knew this day would come sooner or later. Not even someone like her is an exception. But tell me, what bright idea did you stumble on?
attributes.name: Noisy 'Mini-House'

attributes.content: Did you figure out what your tests were lacking, Closure?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Yep. I also know how to bring her back.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The Sarcophagus as both energy source and life pod. Memories formed from Kal'tsit's original data. Blank Originium, i.e., Oka, as a structural base... then add the base-level code we just found.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I've been treating the resurrection experiments as a biological problem this entire time. I never thought of life as a long-running program until now. It's not static code.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Maybe what makes Kal'tsit unique is precisely her self-modification command. Rather than just being a structural alteration as designed, it also set up a self-invoking closed loop.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Inside that information flow space, I saw a few things.
If we go with your metaphor—;Kal'tsit chose to maintain this 'closed loop' of her own accord.

attributes.content: ...Maybe from the moment she set up the closed loop, she was no longer just an executed program. She began to upgrade herself, to iterate.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Then that very first self-modification command can be said to be the start of her 'awareness'.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'll admit, I don't really get stuff of the 'revenants'... But if, say, something has been carved onto the deepest part of her soul, or if that something represents her will as a person—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Then it has to be that command.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: Time to get to work, Closure.

attributes.content: Closure takes out the storage containing the data extracted from the Sarcophagus, and attaches it to a hard disk and heat sink.
Black cables stretch out from an ad-hoc computer case, linking to a support rack cobbled together from a glass cabin.
The 'calcite' representing the base-level code cannot be extracted from the data dump storage, so it is pinned to the center of the open space.
Oka is kept within transparent glass tubes, a little less compared to when the team set out.
A portable life pod is deployed, and within the open space, the borders of a simulated Sarcophagus data environment are delineated, like a 'pond' of pure white.
With everything ready, Closure starts the power, and waits for the screen to light up.

attributes.text: System booting...

attributes.content: Her eyes are locked to the screen as she taps out the last few commands, not hesitating for even a second.
Everything had to be done speedily and smoothly for this experiment to work.

attributes.text: Biological model construction—————100%
\n\nPhysiological function simulation—————100%
\n\nNeuron data upload—————100%

attributes.content: Did it...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: The prompt they had never seen before finally leaps onto the screen. Everyone holds their breath.

attributes.text: Initiate life-phase transition?

attributes.content: Several pairs of eager eyes look towards Closure.
She presses 'Yes'.
Welcome back.
Kal'tsit.
